title: Creamy Tomato Scramble
description: A quick, protein-rich scramble that uses up the milk and tomatoes before they spoil.

instructions.title: Prep
instructions.description: Whisk the eggs with a splash of milk, salt and pepper, and dice the tomatoes.

instructions.title: Soften
instructions.description: Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and soften the tomatoes.
instructions.tip: Use a non-stick pan so the eggs release cleanly.

instructions.title: Scramble
instructions.description: Pour in the eggs and stir gently until just set, then serve immediately.
